applyTo: "apps/**"

# PLAY app FUN-FIRST gate

For ordinary PLAY gameplay files, read and obey:

- `apps/AGENTS.md`
- `docs/PLAY_FUN_FIRST.md`
- `GAME_QUALITY.md`

Before substantial implementation, create/update `apps/<slug>/FUN_REPORT.json` with the fun statement, core loop, meaningful tradeoff, peak five-second moment, and one-more-run reason.

After implementation, actually play the game in a browser and record concrete evidence for the 10-second, 30-second, 3-minute, 10-minute-or-equivalent, retry, and no-reward tests. Do not mark tests as passed from source inspection alone.

Do not claim completion unless the report passes the mechanical FUN gate and relevant production verification.
